_comment: Acceptance thresholds for the DB stress test. Written BEFORE the dry run and the full run (2026-10-10). Only SLO-02 and SLO-04 in docs/SLO.md touch the database; every other limit below is a PROPOSAL awaiting owner approval (open decision), not an accepted SLO.

_sources.SLO-02: docs/SLO.md: full 7-gate governance evaluation P99 <= 2000 ms. DB reads are one part of that budget; proposal: DB share <= 5% (100 ms p99).
_sources.SLO-04: docs/SLO.md: zero unhandled write failures in governance_outcomes and training_log.

checks.metric: Garmin sync persist (one weekly sync tx) p95, main load
Garmin sync persist p99, main load
'database is locked' failures with <= 4 workers (any mode)
lost or phantom rows after concurrency runs
new training_log rows from repeated syncs
rows left after crash inside an outer transaction
re-import after crash gives exact row count, no duplicates
harness peak RSS during main load
initial import throughput via real Garmin path (activity rows/s, persist only)
